About the data

Source: NHS England, Monthly Diagnostics Waiting Times and Activity (DM01), the provider-level "Provider by Test" sheet of each monthly file, from April 2024 to the latest published month. Figures are as published, including later revisions where NHS England republished a month.

Waiting list counts people still waiting for one of 15 key diagnostic tests at the end of the month, by completed weeks waited since referral. "All tests" is the total across the 15. Region is the NHS England commissioning region the provider reports under: North Cumbria Integrated Care sits in North East and Yorkshire, not North West. Provider type treats NHS trusts (three-character codes starting R) as NHS and every other provider as independent sector.

Small providers can swing sharply from month to month, so their percentages are hidden by default. Data from April 2024 to August 2026, built on 2 November 2026. Source: NHS England statistics. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. This is an independent summary of published statistics, not an official NHS England product, and uses no patient-level or unpublished data.
